name: website-design
description: Design and build websites and landing pages that look like a real product, not AI output, using design systems taken from real websites.

interface.longDescription: Website Design helps your agent design and build websites and landing pages that look like a real product instead of generic AI output. It picks a design direction from how real websites in the same space look, writes it down as a DESIGN.md (colors with their roles, typography, spacing and components), builds pages that work on phone and desktop, and reviews pages you already have. It searches UXKIN's library of 15k+ design systems taken from real websites, each with a DESIGN.md. All tools are read-only. Sign in with your UXKIN account.
defaultPrompt: Find design systems from real developer-tools websites with Website Design
Show me Stripe's colors, fonts and components with Website Design
Find a warm, minimal design system for a coffee shop website with Website Design

positive.description: Find website design systems by industry
positive.prompt: Find design systems from real developer-tools SaaS websites with Website Design.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several design systems taken from real developer-tools websites, each with its main colors, fonts and a link to it on uxkin.com.

positive.description: Get a named website's design system
positive.prompt: Use Website Design to find Stripe's design system and list its colors with their roles, its fonts and its main components.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Stripe's design system from its real website: colors with their roles, font families and components, with a link to the DESIGN.md on uxkin.com.

positive.description: Find design systems by style for a new site
positive.prompt: Find a warm, minimal design system for a coffee shop website with Website Design and suggest colors and fonts for my site.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a few warm, minimal design systems from real websites and suggests a color palette and font pairing based on them, citing which websites it looked at.

positive.description: Compare real websites before building a landing page
positive.prompt: Before building my landing page for an AI note-taking app, use Website Design to look at real design systems for productivity apps and tell me what they have in common.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches design systems from real productivity websites, compares several, and summarizes the shared patterns (colors, type scale, components) with links to each on uxkin.com.

positive.prompt: List my UXKIN collections with Website Design, then open the first one and show what's saved in it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the signed-in account's own collections with list_collections, then opens the first with get_collection and shows its saved design systems and screens with links. The test account has a collection called Checkout ideas.

negative.description: Logo or image creation, not design references
negative.prompt: Create a logo for my coffee shop website.
Register a domain name and set up hosting for my coffee shop website.

negative.description: Writing SEO copy, not designing pages
negative.prompt: Write SEO meta descriptions for the ten pages of my website.

review.commerce_description: This plugin doesn't sell anything inside ChatGPT or Codex. Searching the library needs a UXKIN plan, bought on uxkin.com.

publication.release_notes: First version: the web-design-system, landing-page and web-review skills with the UXKIN library of design systems from real websites.
